headline: Euronext Athens: 17-Year Highs, Up 229% Since 2021, Market Capitalization Increase of €140 Billion
summary: The Euronext Athens market is heading for a sixth consecutive year of positive returns at 17-year highs. The main index has gained 229% since end-2020, adding €140 billion in market capitalization.
why: Euronext Athens is Greece's main equity market, and its performance reflects investor sentiment toward Greek companies and the Greek economy.
